## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 5, 2026 - Aug 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _C.W.2026_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used ClassPass consistently and used to genuinely love it. I currently pay $49/month for 23 credits, and there were times when I could take 3–4 classes per week because many of the classes I regularly attended were only 2–4 credits. That has changed drastically. Classes at my regular yoga studio that I historically booked for 2–4 credits are now regularly 4+ credits, and I recently saw a Buti Yoga class listed for 10 credits. That ONE class would use almost half of my entire monthly allowance. ClassPass says pricing fluctuates based on demand, but I’ve attended higher-credit classes that were nowhere near full, which makes the pricing feel arbitrary and incredibly difficult to plan around. What makes this even more frustrating is that the solution ClassPass continually pushes is upgrading to a more expensive plan. But paying more money for additional credits doesn’t solve the underlying problem when the number of credits required per class keeps increasing too. I shouldn’t have to continually increase my monthly spending just to maintain roughly the same fitness routine my existing plan previously allowed. I loved ClassPass because it made fitness more accessible and gave me flexibility. Now the unpredictable credit inflation is actively interfering with the routine I built using the service. Unless the credit system becomes more reasonable and transparent, I’m seriously considering canceling altogether."
            2. _CalifAndrUSA_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "try to cancel subscription and see how ugly they get trying to keep you in. No value in this where I live, but the product and user mishandling is phenomenal as they try to push their nothing service on you not letting you go… brrr"
            3. _Allie Galbraith_, Aug 8, 2026, 5/5: "I was instructed by my favorite reformer Pilates instructor @MightyPilates to get ClassPass because I disclosed to him the ridiculous & unsettling amount of money I was spending per month on additional classes (additional classes I wished to take per week that were not covered by my set monthly class package which is/was ~$400, the most MightyPilates offers). Since downloading and using Clasd pass, it has become my first choice for booking classes, and it also inspires me to try other nearby reformer Pilates studios that are less expensive or newer! It has been a LIFESAVER"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Aug 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _kgk_kcc_, Aug 13, 2026, 1/5: "Can’t get anything fixed now that customer service went to AI. Good luck if you have any issues with your account, billing, etc. Awful experience"
            2. _MoRoNe93ahshsh_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "The 14 day trial is just a straight up lie. As soon as you sign up for it you see that you can’t actually book anything with it- it even shows classes available to you specifically with the trial membership and when you try to book it says you have to upgrade. Also the app itself is soooo awful and buggy- nothing works."
            3. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
